# Trendora

Practical lifestyle guides. AI-generated illustration use is disclosed on applicable pages.

## Guides
- [6 Small Gaming Room Setup Ideas for a Calm, Organized Space](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/small-gaming-room-setup-ideas/): Plan a small gaming room with practical desk layouts, comfortable lighting, tidy cables and a console corner that fits everyday living.
- [Warm Lighting Ideas for a Cozy Burrowcore Home](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/warm-lighting-burrowcore-ideas/): Create a cozy reading corner, calmer bedroom and welcoming kitchen with shaded lamps, layered light and a practical room-by-room plan.
- [3 Short Fall Nail Colors to Try: Chocolate, Cherry and Olive](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/short-fall-nail-colors/): Three wearable autumn manicure ideas with original visual references, finish comparisons and a simple checklist for your next salon appointment.
- [23 Soft Wolf Cut Ideas for Men That Look Modern, Textured and Easy to Style](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/soft-wolf-cut-men/): From soft waves and curtain fringe to subtle mullet length and cleaner tapered sides, these wolf cut ideas keep the shape modern without making it look overdone.
- [21 Home Café Ideas & Coffee Recipes That Make Mornings Feel Like a Coffee Shop](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/home-cafe-coffee-ideas/): From banana syrup coffee and blueberry lattes to a compact espresso corner, these home café ideas make everyday coffee feel more personal, organized and fun.
- [19 Perfume Layering Ideas That Smell Expensive and Completely Unique](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/perfume-layering-ideas/): From vanilla and amber to fig and woods, these easy fragrance pairings show how to build a more personal scent without turning your perfume routine into guesswork.
- [17 Kitchen Witch & Herbal Apothecary Ideas That Make a Kitchen Feel Magical](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/kitchen-witch-herbal-apothecary/): Amber bottles, labeled herb jars, loose-leaf tea, dried botanicals and warm wooden shelves can turn an ordinary kitchen corner into a practical apothecary-inspired space.
- [21 Milky Lilac Nail Ideas That Look Soft, Glossy and Expensive](https://alperen15100.github.io/Trendora/milky-lilac-nails/): From sheer lavender milk to glazed lilac chrome, these soft manicure ideas make purple feel polished, wearable and surprisingly luxe.
